_about: Acetic acid (1) + Propionic acid (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetic acid, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Gao, D.[Daming], Zhu, D.[Dechun], Sun, H.[Hong], Zhang, L.[Linyun], Chen, H.[Hong], Si, J.[Jingyu], Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Binary and Ternary Mixtures of Methanol, Ethanoic Acid, and Propanoic Acid, J. Chem. Eng. Data 55 (2010) 4002-4009
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.47 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
